summary: No SPY bet: the AI and chip selling goes on for a second day (SPY -2.0%, QQQ -3.0%, SMH -5.0% pre-market) and October's PCE came in as expected on the headline with core a tenth hot (3.3% against 3.2%) and third-quarter GDP revised up to 4.3%; the gap is priced at the open and nothing says which way the session goes from there.
reasons: Why down (CNBC, Benzinga, investinglive): the AI sell-off returns for a second session, led by Nvidia (the board's probe of Jensen Huang after his return is still in the news) and Anthropic, which one report puts below its IPO price; Dell beat and raised but trades -5% to -8%, Workday beat and trades -5% to -10%; Ambarella -34%. Microsoft declared a 'code red' after a large outage (Benzinga 20:01). One aggregator puts December hike odds near 99.8% (single source, not confirmed).

08:30 data (BEA release pages, read 08:33): October PCE prices +0.3% on the month and 3.8% on the year (consensus 0.3% and 3.8%); core +0.3% and 3.3% (consensus 3.2%, September 3.1%); personal income +0.7%, spending +0.3%, real spending flat, saving rate 4.1%. Third-quarter GDP second estimate 4.3% annualized, up from 3.4%. A hot-leaning set for a Fed already priced to hike on 12-09, but SPY went from 705.22 at 08:00 to 704.16 at 08:31 and TLT rose (+0.9% from Tuesday's close): the print did not move the tape. Not a put day: futures red and core hot, but yields down, not up (S4 needs them aligned).

Monday and Tuesday: SPY gapped +5.0% and closed 0.28% under its open; on Tuesday it gapped -1.0% and closed +0.50% above its open. R1: the gap is priced at the open. No base rate is quoted today: the one on file (the day after an open-to-close of -2% or worse in a falling month) does not apply, Tuesday's open-to-close was positive.

Sniper: KO call, class target. BNP Paribas raises Coca-Cola's target to $107 from $102 (Benzinga 06:31, the rating not stated, so taken as kept); BNP also raised PepsiCo (to $160) and P&G (to $197). KO is +0.7% pre-market (under T7's 1.5% for a target raise), staples are the one heating group (XLP +4.5% 1m, above its 20-day average), no report inside the window. Against it: R4, a target change is in the price by 09:32 and the class has shown no edge at a price that can be bought; the stock sits 2% under its median target (100, Webull, 21 of 26 buy or strong buy) and near its one-year high (100.56); the nearest expiry is Friday's half day. Shadow only (S2).

No ideas listed (T6): every chip and AI name gaps down with the group; the names green or flat (KO, PG, PEP, WMT, COST, LLY, V) are relative strength, not a cause of their own, apart from the target raises in the sniper line. No morning put idea: not a put day.

Report window (R3): DELL, WDAY, ADSK and HPQ reported last night (today is the reaction day); DE reported this morning; ADI and HPE are on day two. CRM and MRVL report next week (MRVL 12-01). None of our 25 names reports this week.

Theme states at the 11-24 close: chips neutral (REL_WEAK, BREADTH), optical neutral (REL_WEAK, BREADTH; PERIPH_UP), software, internet, energy and power neutral (BREADTH), consumer neutral with heat flags (REL_STRONG, BREADTH_UP), health BREADTH_UP; light lit: breadth; stretched not lit. Described, not forecast (R6).

Pre-market down gaps of 3% or more among the large caps: NVDA, AMD, MU, SNDK, INTC, ARM, AVGO, TSM, ORCL, LITE, CIEN, WDC, STX, MRVL, GEV, VST, PLTR, GOOGL, MSFT, CAT, DELL, WDAY, DE. nvda_gapdown_put (real ledger, $691) can fire at 10:00 if NVDA is still 0.1% under its open; R2 says NVDA gaps of -3% or worse closed above their open 56% of the time.

zh.summary: 今天不下注。AI 和芯片股连续第二天被抛：盘前标普 -2.0%、纳指 -3.0%、芯片 ETF -5.0%。8:30 的通胀数据：核心通胀同比 3.3%，比预期高 0.1；三季度经济增速上修到 4.3%。数据偏热，但公布后标普盘前几乎没动，长期国债反而涨。低开已经算进开盘价，开盘后往哪边走看不出理由，我写 0.48。
zh.sniper: 可口可乐看涨，只记影子。法巴今早把它的目标价从 107 上调（原 102），同时上调了百事和宝洁。盘前 +0.7%，必需消费是现在唯一在升温的一组。信心 0.25：目标价调整到 9:32 基本已经反映在价格里（我们查过两年），股价离分析师目标中位数 100 只差 2%，最近的期权是周五半天到期。10:00 如果在开盘价下方就算错。
